text: My daughter is 1 month old (born just over four weeks ago). Her temperature is 39.5. She's had a runny, snuffly nose and has been sneezing since yesterday. Tonight I noticed some small dark red-purple spots on her tummy and they don't fade when I press a glass on them. Her skin also looks quite pale and blotchy, mottled on her legs and arms. She's feeding normally, took her full bottle an hour ago. Let me know what you want me to do.
